pages.title: Cosmic Transmutation
pages.text: To enter the next $(item)Simulation$() you need to find a way to $(item)transmute$() some of the ores you've found so far into $(item)Ardite Ore$() and $(item)Cobalt Ore$().$(br2)With a $(item)Pristine Ocular Lens$(), and a little help from the gods, you will be able to obtain these ores in no time.

pages.title: Cosmic Transmutation
pages.text: You can temporarily repurpose your $(item)Altar of Blessings$() into a $(item)Altar of Cosmic Transmutation$() by replacing the $(item)Blood Raven Feather$() in the $(item)Spectral Relay$() with a $(item)Pristine Ocular Lens$().$(br2)This altar will let you transmute $(item)Copper$() into $(item)Ardite$() when using an $(item)Orange$() lens, and $(item)Silver$() into $(item)Cobalt$() when using a $(item)Blue$() lens.$(br2)Lenses are not consumed after a transmutation.

The $(item)Rich Slag$() required is most easily obtained through smelting down $(item)Redstone Ore$() with sand in an $(item)Induction Smelter$().$(br2)$(item)Redstone Ore$() is obtained by mining it with a silk touch tool.

pages.title: Rich Slag
pages.text: Even though this is the most efficient way, you could also just smelt a bunch of random ores with sand. $(br2)The chance for $(item)Rich Slag$() is lower with other ores, but since you should be smelting ores like this anyway for a good while, it does not matter which route you end up taking.
